## What's new in 1.21.6

This update adds support for right-to-left writing and makes the list window easier to use.

### Right-to-left writing

- Text now follows its own direction. A field, a title or a paragraph that starts in Arabic, Hebrew or Persian is written and aligned right to left as you type.
- Ctrl+Right Shift and Ctrl+Left Shift work like in other Windows apps. They switch the current field, or the current note paragraph, to right-to-left or left-to-right, including text you've already typed.
- In notes and the journal, the direction you choose is saved with the note. In a list, the whole item switches, bullet or checkbox included.

### Lists

- The window for creating or editing a list now uses two columns. It fits on screen without scrolling, buttons included.

## Install

Download `Aqueli_1.21.6_x64-setup.exe` below and run it. It installs Aqueli for your Windows user account, without administrator rights, and keeps your data from the previous version.

The installer is not code-signed yet: if Windows SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC", choose More info, then Run anyway.
